import subprocess
result = subprocess.check_output('wmic cpu get loadpercentage', shell=True, encoding='utf-8')
lines = result.split('\n')
usage_values = [line.strip() for line in lines if line.strip().isdigit()]
if usage_values:
    print(f'{usage_values[0]}%')
else:
    print('CPU 사용률 정보를 가져오지 못했습니다.')

import subprocess
result = subprocess.check_output('wmic logicaldisk get caption,freespace,size', shell=True, encoding='utf-8')
lines = result.strip().split('\n')
print('디스크 용량 정보:')
for line in lines[1:]:
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) == 3:
        drive, free, total = parts
        if free.isdigit() and total.isdigit():
            free_gb = int(free) // (1024 ** 3)
            total_gb = int(total) // (1024 ** 3)
            print(f'{drive}: {free_gb}GB / {total_gb}GB')

import subprocess
import time
print('인터넷 속도를 측정 중입니다... 잠시만 기다려주세요.')
url = 'http://speedtest.tele2.net/10MB.zip'
start_time = time.time()
subprocess.run(f'powershell Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "{url}" -OutFile NUL', shell=True)
end_time = time.time()
time_taken = end_time - start_time
if time_taken > 0:
    download_speed = 10 / time_taken
    print(f'다운로드 속도: {download_speed:.2f} MB/s')
else:
    print('인터넷 속도 측정에 실패했습니다.')
